Name: Sekun's Buildable Greenhouses
Author: RiftstalkerSekun
Description:
Do you love the small, cute, feature-rich greenhouse maps, but also yearn for a bigger greenhouse to help make better use of your farm space? Do you want giant crops to grow inside your extra greenhouses? Then yearn no more, the solution has arrived!

Buildable Greenhouses doesn't reuse your existing greenhouse map when you have Robin build you a new greenhouse. Instead, greenhouses come in four different sizes, each with their own individual map! It's also very modular with its config file options. Don't want to even see, much less build, a certain size greenhouse? Use the config files to remove it completely from Robin's Build menu! This won't remove any instances of that greenhouse that already exist on your farm, but Robin can still destroy them just like any other building. Do you hate fruit trees, and thus want the orchard section turned into more precious, precious dirt? There's a config option for that, too! Same for if you don't like the pre-planned layouts in the larger greenhouses, one config click and they're gone! This mod is fully GMCM compatible to suit your needs, and only needs Content Patcher to work! It also reuses the vanilla greenhouse exterior, and thus should be compatible with any reskin mods that change the vanilla greenhouse exterior.

Greenhouses come in one of four sizes, and are unlocked at Robin's shop once you unlock the base vanilla Greenhouse. They have a footprint size of 7x6 tiles, or the same as the vanilla greenhouse, minus the 6 stone 'patio' tiles on the front.

Mini Greenhouse: This greenhouse is the smallest of them. It holds 2x3 Iridium sprinklers, for a total of 144 crops, and 10 trees. The greenhouse for when Grandpa says no, you have greenhouses at home.

Medial Greenhouse: This greenhouse is medium-sized. It has two plots that each hold 5x5 Iridium sprinklers, for a total of 1200 crops, and 36 trees.

Macro Greenhouse: This greenhouse is pretty large. It comes with a pre-planning option to make 6 plots that hold 500 crops each once sprinklers are placed down, for a grand total of 3000 crops, and has space in the orchard for 72 trees.

Ludeonicrous Greenhouse: It's a Rimworld map size reference! This greenhouse also comes with a pre-planning option to make 12 plots that hold 500 crops each AND two plots that hold 1000 crops each, for a combined total of 8000 crops once sprinklers are placed down, and a whopping 144 fruit trees.


Looking for more crops to grow inside your greenhouses, or for a farm map with lots of room to build them in? Then check out my other mods!
